pins.definition: A shop where medicines are prepared and sold.
A shop where you can buy medicine and get medical advice from a professional.
A shop where you buy medicine and health products.

situation: A customer hands a prescription across a high counter to a person in a white coat, surrounded by shelves packed with medicine bottles.
subject: the rows of medicine bottles and the dispensing counter
brief: Behind a polished wooden counter, a person in a crisp white coat hands a small amber medicine bottle across to a waiting customer, while floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with neat rows of colorful pill boxes and remedy bottles fill the background.
prompt: Behind a polished wooden counter, a person in a crisp white coat hands a small amber medicine bottle across to a waiting customer, while floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with neat rows of colorful pill boxes and remedy bottles fill the background. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
